purpose: Authoritative reuse-rights review for the highest-value measured waveform sources that were blocked only because public download availability had not yet been tied to explicit dataset reuse terms.

sources.evidence: The authoritative RWTH Publications dataset record explicitly displays Creative Commons Attribution CC BY 4.0 and provides the OpenAccess ExperimentalData.zip file.
sources.nextAction: Retrieve ExperimentalData.zip, fingerprint files, enumerate experiment/cycle structure, separate controller experiments from part-mass iterations, and count only delivered measured time-series samples.

sources.evidence: The B2SHARE record is openly downloadable and exposes a Rights > License field, but the licence value is blank on the authoritative record.
sources.nextAction: Obtain explicit dataset reuse terms from SKZ/B2SHARE before automated waveform ingestion.

sources.evidence: The Zenodo record describes the data as open access and exposes downloadable cycle CSVs, but the authoritative record does not display an explicit licence identifier or licence text.
sources.nextAction: Obtain explicit dataset reuse terms before automated enumeration or ingestion of the cycle files.

sources.evidence: The Zenodo record makes the multimodal files publicly downloadable but does not display an explicit dataset licence identifier or licence text.
sources.nextAction: Obtain explicit data reuse terms and then pin the release version before multimodal ingestion.

sources.evidence: The Zenodo record exposes a 685.5 MB archive and linked software repositories, but its Rights > License section does not display a licence value. A software-repository licence is not treated as a licence for the archived dataset.
sources.nextAction: Obtain explicit dataset reuse terms before download; when executable, count only injection-moulding experiment streams and exclude downstream screw-driving observations from injection sample totals.

evidenceBoundary: This review changes execution eligibility only. It does not promote a dataset to fully profiled measured evidence and does not change accepted measured-sample counts until actual source files are lawfully retrieved, fingerprinted, profiled and reconciled.
